finding: Verified helper source may not be the executed code: SourceFileLoader can read existing __cached__ bytecode, while helper_module is not inserted into sys.modules and runtime_paths only enumerates sys.modules. dont_write_bytecode prevents writes, not reads.
impact: Helper pyc can be absent from protected inputs; a pinned .py hash does not identify actual executed helper bytes. This is a static reachable gap, not an observed bad pyc or executed failure.
minimal_fix: Read helper bytes once, verify those bytes against registered SHA, then types.ModuleType plus exec(compile(raw, path, exec)) without SourceFileLoader. Keep helper .py itself in every freeze. Alternatively prove and freeze actual bytecode before loading, but raw compile is the narrow established pattern.
required_recheck: New immutable runner/scope hash; AST/static diff only before Root registration. No retry authorized by this review.

finding: prepare stores resources.before then export/gofmt/go-version/go-list run; self.guarded is replaced at255 by current hashes without first comparing the original resource baseline. The postbuild check then compares against this rebased vector.
impact: A controller/tool/SDK/resource change during export or go-list can be absorbed into the new prepared baseline instead of rejecting drift. Later execute verification cannot reconstruct original prepare bytes.
minimal_fix: Retain immutable resources_before vector; compare it after export/list and before forming expanded input baseline; recheck it at final preparation before prepared.json publication. Preserve original before and actual after reports on any failure. Do not replace original pins with observed new hashes.
required_recheck: New immutable runner hash and prepare scope; original execute grant preparedSHA requirement unchanged.
